steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: So this is the legendary Rhodes Island. It certainly has an almost mystical air to it...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: There's something familiar about this atmosphere. Hmm...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: If I hadn't boarded this ark, I would've thought I was still at the beach.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We had a few Ægirians here lately.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I suppose you're also from Ægir, but I didn't see your name on the guest list. Perhaps that means I can't treat you as a guest.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Haha, sorry about that, but I'm not here to bother you. I just have a few words for you before I leave.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Wait, you even know my name?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Anyone at Siesta these days would know who you are.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even though I didn't go myself, I did hear about you before. Miss Alty, bassist of Alive Until Sunset, Rhodes Island is not an amusement park.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Oh come on, don't be so unfriendly. After all, there are so many things we have in common. That's right, why don't we talk about when we could still see the stars?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Have a seat.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Thank you. You must be curious how I got in here, right?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: That's not important, but don't worry. There's nothing wrong with the security system. Just consider me lucky.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your words can't hide your abilities. As you said, I'm not particularly worried. I suppose the system only makes an exception for when the guest is important enough.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But I wonder, what would make a superstar take interest in our small, little ward here?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you're looking for your Ægirian friends, I'm afraid you've got the wrong address.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Friends? Well... we don't really get along? If anything, I'd say we're far from friends...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Actually, I'm here for you. Or rather, I'm here to take a look at you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sorry, but I don't know who you are, nor am I some display at a zoo.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I've heard a lot about the Ægirians from Frost. She's not normally one to tell stories, but she did make an exception that time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not interested in your friend's bizarre adventures either...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: How about I sing it out then?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...nor am I interested in any random anecdotes about me. Just get to the point.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Someone once told me that a bit of chit-chat is good for breaking the ice, but I suppose I'm no good at that...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Well, let's begin then. Actually, I kind of hate Ægirians. Of course, I know about how pitiful their past is.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But if you didn't show up, these Ægirians would already have been devoured by the abyssal depths by now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I didn't do anything in particular.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: You saved their lives, and several of them are here.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: These special Ægirians don't show any respect to you, despite all that you did for them.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I suppose you were too grumpy around them?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm just preventing them from destroying themselves.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: That is also a form of mercy, doctor.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But, I do have a question for you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ask away.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Do you know who the enemy of the Ægir is?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Or perhaps, do you know who I really am?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr, stop!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...You're still young.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: That's right, we are very young, and we haven't been through any of those tragedies. That's why we're still here, just talking and singing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Abyssal Hunters are doing what they should be doing.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: This I know, all too well. However, we'd also like to know the answer.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: We have no desire to become the enemies of those little guys at all.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: You see, ever since she was little, Frost was only interested in music and food. Even resting was a waste of time to her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can save your friend's introduction for when we actually meet.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Sorry, bad habit of mine...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I trust you, doctor, and the truth you have.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I don't think you know any less about the truth than I do.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: No, we just each have our own strengths. For example, I don't think you can sing as well as I do.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Ah, um, that's just an example! No offense intended.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But the peace in Ægir, as you know, is only superficial.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Most people know nothing about the sea.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: How are the children of Terra supposed to know that? It's not good to expect too much out of them.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: However, even that superficial peace is about to be broken. Desire really is a terrifying thing.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: So, what I need is, well, information.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Information again?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: So in other words... Uhh, I'm not the only one who's interested in this. Haha.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I'm just a bit curious, who might that last person be?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: An Ægirian, and an Abyssal Hunter.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Then maybe we could be friends, like, for real. Heh.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Of course. I can understand why you've come to see me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The longer you live, the more stories you have, the worse your scars hurt, and the worse your temperament becomes.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to remind you of the past...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But, you really are different from the others. They are bound by too many emotions, easily manipulated by words, and sometimes turn into disasters in their own right.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: No wonder that person assigned you as the trump card to help that little bunny and {@nickname}.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: You really are an X-ray machine, aren't you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I also wish I was a simple machine.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Sorry about that. But what I meant to say was, even though you won't tell anyone, you've already seen what lies underneath, right?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I can't answer that.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: All right, I'll skip to the main question then. Surely you'll be able to answer this one.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Go ahead, young superstar.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Oh, thank you.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Please tell me everything you know about what happened underneath that part of the ocean.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's not a form of 'information.'

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: No, I'm talking about 'That' part of the ocean.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Frost is the youngest one among us. Only the four of us can be considered young.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: She smelled something from those Ægirians. A scent that didn't belong to them.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: 'They can't sing anymore. They can't talk anymore. They're drifting farther and farther away from us. They're becoming hungry.'

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: AMa-10 Dr. Kal'tsit, please tell me... How were those special Ægirians born?
